A single topical application of a 0.1% tacrolimus ointment to an infant for the treatment of chronic dermatitis, re- sulted in high serum-tacrolimus concentrations (24 nanograms/mL). Tacrolimus levels decreased over 7 days, after which another smaller, single application of 0.03% tac- rolimus ointment again resulted in high serum concentrations.
